note: GROUND TRUTH for lib/core/camera-measure.ts — the real hue masks of real rendered mp4 frames.
maskRuns is a flat run-length encoding of the hue mask, starting with an OFF run: [off,on,off,on,...].
WHAT THIS COVERS on real pixel data: connected components, the disc shape filter, the RANSAC
correspondence, the residual gate, and the zoom arithmetic. WHAT IT DOES NOT COVER: the RGB->hue
thresholding that produced the mask (covered synthetically in camera-measure.test.ts) and frame
decoding (covered by re-running the CLI above).
expect.zoom is what the tool reads and is a REGRESSION LOCK. expect.published is the number
skills/map-native/src/core/tour-box.ts independently records for that beat — that is the real
ground truth, and the named tests assert against it, not against the captured value.

renders.codecNoise: Two renders of the SAME config by the SAME code differ in file bytes (sha256 2703230... vs af3c213..., sizes 10359783 vs 10359730) yet produced BIT-IDENTICAL hue masks and identical readings. See L5 in camera-measure.ts.
